title: H. E. L. Y.’S filed before him, tallwhitehatted, past Tangier lane, plodding towards their goal.
html_source: The parade of demarcated capital letters reflects the filing past of each member of the sandwichmen, each of whom bears a different letter for advertising a company where Bloom once worked. He had observed them earlier, in the “Lestrygonians” episode.
